values.fixture: one tenant: an assertion Verifier of four `equals` checks over one 2 KiB `context` slot, a Model, and one Service per application with its own Card-bound family runtime key; every odd arrival answers check `d` wrong, so both verdicts stay in every window
values.limits: server defaults on the whole host; no resource quota

timing.method: server benchmark histograms: integer nanoseconds from the owning server boundary's std::time::Instant timers, recorded into bounded HDR histograms and read as cumulative snapshots from the loopback metrics listener; each window is the bucket-count difference of two snapshots of one process
timing.precision: 3 significant digits; each percentile is judged on its whole bucket's bounds
timing.percentile: nearest rank ceil(q * N) over the window's distribution
timing.tracing: operator span export stays at its default (disabled); no span is required for timing
timing.assignment: every request carries its closed case and the repetition or admission phase that admitted it, attached when its request span opens; a window takes the observations recorded between its opening snapshot and one taken after its admitted cohort drained, so a late completion stays in its admitted cohort; each cohort's judged-outcome count must equal the completions the driver saw, other outcomes (retried or refused attempts) are counted beside it; a short or extra count, a dropped or out-of-range observation, an unknown label, a missing or negative component, scans that are not the answered cohort's, or a replaced process makes it invalid
timing.measurement: work, wall seconds, and server and driver CPU stop at the admission stop, before the requests then in flight drain; their completions count as late work beside the measured work, and their latency stays in the final cohort
timing.evidence: each window's full opening and drained snapshots are kept under the run's target artifacts as timings/<step>/<phase>.json; the record keeps each cohort's reconciliation and each percentile's rank and bucket bounds

values.workload: closed-loop public-client `observe().verify` (direct mode), one application per client, each sending its next call once the last answers
